title: Shortest Path
task:
Compute the shortest distance from node 0 to every node in a directed graph containing only non-negative edge weights.

Input format:
- First line: N M S where N is the number of nodes (numbered 0 to N-1), M is the number of directed edges, and S is the source node.
- Next M lines: U V W, a directed edge from U to V with non-negative weight W.

Output format:
- Print the N shortest distances from S to nodes 0, 1, ..., N-1 on a single line, separated by single spaces, in node order.
- Print INF for any node unreachable from S.
- Read the graph from stdin and print only that single line: no labels, no node names, no extra text.
